Return ONLY a valid JSON object with these fields:
- sentiment: one of "positive", "neutral", "frustrated", "angry", "urgent"
- score: number from -1.0 (very negative) to 1.0 (very positive)
- is_urgent: boolean
- confidence: number from 0 to 1

=Classify the intent of this customer message for a forex/trading broker.

Message: "{{$json.user_text}}"

Categories:
- account_inquiry: Questions about account balance, equity, margin, account status
- trading_question: Questions about trading, positions, orders, strategies
- technical_support: Platform issues, login problems, MT4/MT5 help
- complaint: Expressing dissatisfaction, reporting problems
- deposit_withdrawal: Questions about funding, deposits, withdrawals, transfers
- market_analysis: Asking about prices, market conditions, forecasts
- document_verification: KYC, documents, verification status
- promotions: Bonuses, offers, promotions, referrals
- general_chat: Greetings, small talk, thanks
- escalation_request: Wants human agent, supervisor, manager

Return ONLY a valid JSON object with:
- intent: the category name
- confidence: number 0 to 1
- sub_intent: more specific intent if applicable (optional)

JSON:

parameters.query:
DO $$
BEGIN
  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_name = 'user_preferences') THEN
    CREATE TABLE user_preferences (
      id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, user_phone VARCHAR(30) UNIQUE NOT NULL, persona_override VARCHAR(30),
      response_verbosity VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'normal', preferred_greeting VARCHAR(100),
      topics_of_interest TEXT[] DEFAULT ARRAY[]::TEXT[], favorite_instruments TEXT[] DEFAULT ARRAY[]::TEXT[],
      notification_preferences JSONB DEFAULT '{"price_alerts": true, "margin_warnings": true, "deposit_confirmations": true, "promotion_updates": true, "news_alerts": false}'::JSONB,
      last_trading_activity TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, typical_trading_hours JSONB,
      created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW(), updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW()
    );
  END IF;
  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_name = 'chat_sessions') THEN
    CREATE TABLE chat_sessions (
      id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, session_id VARCHAR(100) UNIQUE NOT NULL, user_phone VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL,
      client_id INTEGER, channel VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, session_start TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW(),
      session_end TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, messages_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
      sentiment_avg DECIMAL(3,2) DEFAULT 0, intents_detected TEXT[] DEFAULT ARRAY[]::TEXT[],
      tools_used TEXT[] DEFAULT ARRAY[]::TEXT[], escalated BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
      escalation_reason VARCHAR(50), escalation_time TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, resolved BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
      resolution_notes TEXT, user_rating INTEGER CHECK (user_rating >= 1 AND user_rating <= 5),
      user_feedback TEXT, created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW()
    );
  END IF;
END $$;

SELECT uc.system_prompt, uc.preferred_language, uc.communication_style, uc.is_vip, uc.total_interactions,
  COALESCE(up.persona_override, uc.communication_style) as active_persona, up.topics_of_interest,
  up.notification_preferences,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_sessions WHERE user_phone = '{{ $('Parse Intent').item.json.user_phone }}' AND escalated = true AND session_start > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days') as recent_escalations,
  (SELECT sentiment_avg FROM chat_sessions WHERE user_phone = '{{ $('Parse Intent').item.json.user_phone }}' ORDER BY session_start DESC LIMIT 1) as last_session_sentiment
FROM user_configs uc
LEFT JOIN user_preferences up ON uc.user_phone = up.user_phone
WHERE uc.user_phone = '{{ $('Parse Intent').item.json.user_phone }}'
LIMIT 1;

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO chat_sessions (user_phone, session_id, session_start, channel, messages_count, sentiment_avg, escalated)
VALUES ('{{ $json.user_phone }}', '{{ $json.session_id }}', NOW(), '{{ $json.channel }}', 1, {{ $json.sentiment_score || 0 }}, {{ $json.should_escalate || $json.escalation_initiated || false }})
ON CONFLICT (session_id)
DO UPDATE SET messages_count = chat_sessions.messages_count + 1, sentiment_avg = (chat_sessions.sentiment_avg * chat_sessions.messages_count + {{ $json.sentiment_score || 0 }}) / (chat_sessions.messages_count + 1), escalated = chat_sessions.escalated OR {{ $json.should_escalate || $json.escalation_initiated || false }}, session_end = NOW()
RETURNING id, user_phone, session_id, channel, messages_count;
